_README: Anchor banks for the liquidation-cluster internal-link rebuild. Each target has five anchor categories (exact, close_variants, process, risk_consequence, contextual_longtail) plus a 'negative' list of phrases that must NEVER point here. One phrase points to exactly one target across the whole cluster. ROUTING RULE: broad anchors go to hubs, route-specific anchors go to route pages, decision/comparison anchors go to decision pages. Placement script picks the first natural fit, rotating categories for diversity; no single anchor used more than 6x cluster-wide; exact-match kept to a minority per target.
